products.title: Lifttech Electric Natural Upholstered Ottoman Bed Frame
products.body_html:
Cocoon yourself in luxury with our Liftech Electric Ottoman bed.    Simply press the button and watch your mattress be raised to reveal a fully boarded storage area with built-in lighting.  With up to 4 times the storage of a conventional drawer divan, the mattress can be effortlessly raised to reveal a versatile storage space for all those occasional-use items.  Whereas a conventional ottoman bed will typically have a mattress weight limit of 60kg, the Smart lift Ottoman is designed to take a mattress weight of 80kg and up to 100kg on the Super King Size.  

The bed can be assembled so that it can be accessed from either the left or right-hand side for ease of access.  Finished in a timeless natural weave fabric, the bed can be easily coordinated with other bedroom furnishings.  The bed comes with an auto-lock system that activates after 1 minute.  This safety feature also prevents children from accidentally activating the ottoman when the bed is open or closed.

Rest assured, this product has been extensively tested and conforms to the following standards. EN1725 Strength and Stability, BS5852 Fire Safety, SI 2016 No. 1091 - The Electromagnetic Compatibility Regulations 2016,  SI 2016 No. 1101 - The Electrical Equipment (Safety) 2016, SI 2012 No. 3032 - The Restriction of the Use of Certain Hazardous Substances in Electrical and Electronic Equipment Regulations 2012

Product available to view at our Yorkshire-based showroom from 30th April. Alternatively, we can arrange a video appointment so you can view from the comfort of your home
